entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7034"/><div sID="gen10790" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7034"/>4. Pardon produces filial fear and love. Judgment without the hope of pardon creates fear and dislike. The sense of forgiveness, so far from producing licentiousness, produces holiness (<reference osisRef="Jer.33.9">Jr 33:9</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ezek.16.62">Eze 16:62</reference>, <reference osisRef="Ezek.16.63">63</reference>; <reference osisRef="1Pet.2.16">1Pe 2:16</reference>). "There is forgiveness with thee, not that thou mayest be presumed upon, but feared." <div eID="gen10790" type="x-p"/>
